title: ForAnyValue with IfExists, on a missing key
question: On a missing key, IfExists says the condition holds and ForAnyValue says it doesn't. AWS doesn't say which wins. The analyzer refuses.

cases.name: key_absent
cases.description: ForAnyValue:StringEqualsIfExists aws:TagKeys campus, for a request with no tags.

readings.ALLOW: IfExists wins: a missing key passes
readings.IMPLICIT_DENY: ForAnyValue wins: no values, no match. Or the simulator's handling of a key left out of the call (see calibration)
